hypothesis.statement: Across 50 subjects (ages 18-75), foam-surface COP path length increases with age (positive Pearson correlation); the correlation is stronger on foam than on firm ground; and the newly-authored correlationTest reproduces scipy.stats.pearsonr AND base R cor.test BIT-FOR-BIT.

analysis_plan.dataset: Santos & Duarte (2016) balance dataset (figshare); age vs COP path length (PhysioMoCap::swayMetrics) on eyes-open foam and firm surfaces for 50 subjects

decision.threshold: descriptive: correlationTest equals scipy.stats.pearsonr and base R cor.test to machine precision (|diff| < 1e-9); the age-foam correlation is positive and significant
